90: // NewWebSocketOutput prepares the relay publisher.
91: //
92: // A connection is attempted once, with a short deadline, so a bad URL or token
93: // is visible at stream start. Failure is not fatal: the local Activity stack
94: // can still be booting (it builds a gateway and waits for a tunnel), and
95: // blocking the start of a stream on it would make the hotkey feel broken.
96: // run keeps retrying in the background and publishes as soon as the relay
97: // answers.
98: func NewWebSocketOutput(ctx context.Context, opts WebSocketOptions) (*WebSocketOutput, error) {
99: if strings.TrimSpace(opts.Endpoint) == "" {
100: return nil, errors.New("relay URL is empty")
101: }
102: if strings.TrimSpace(opts.Room) == "" {
103: return nil, errors.New("relay room is empty")
104: }
105: if opts.Logger == nil {
106: opts.Logger = slog.Default()
107: }
108: o := &WebSocketOutput{
109: opts: opts,
110: log: opts.Logger,
111: queue: make(chan outbound, relayQueueDepth),
112: done: make(chan struct{}),
113: }
114:
115: dialCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second)
116: conn, err := o.dial(dialCtx)
117: cancel()
118: if err != nil {
119: o.log.Warn("relay is not reachable yet; the stream will connect in the background",
120: "room", opts.Room, "error", err)
121: o.needsKeyframe.Store(true)
122: } else {
123: o.conn = conn
124: }
125: o.lastLog = time.Now()
126: o.wg.Add(1)
127: go o.run(ctx)
128: return o, nil
129: }

131: // Name identifies the output in logs.
132: func (o *WebSocketOutput) Name() string { return "websocket" }

134: // WriteVideo sends one Annex-B access unit with a keyframe flag.
135: func (o *WebSocketOutput) WriteVideo(sample []byte, timestamp time.Time, \_ time.Duration) error {
136: if len(sample) == 0 {
137: return errors.New("cannot publish an empty H.264 access unit")
138: }
139: info := inspectH264(sample)
140: keyframe := info.hasIDR
141: if o.needsKeyframe.Load() && !keyframe {
142: // The viewer missed pictures, so this delta cannot be decoded. The next
143: // IDR is at most a keyframe interval away.
144: return nil
145: }
146: if keyframe {
147: o.needsKeyframe.Store(false)
148: }
149:
150: o.h264Mu.Lock()
151: if info.sps != nil {
152: o.sps = append(o.sps[:0], info.sps...)
153: }
154: if info.pps != nil {
155: o.pps = append(o.pps[:0], info.pps...)
156: }
157: sample = ensureParameterSets(sample, info, o.sps, o.pps)
158: o.h264Mu.Unlock()
159:
160: flags := byte(0)
161: if keyframe {
162: flags |= relayKeyframe
163: }
164: o.enqueue(outbound{
165: kind: relayVideo,
166: flags: flags,
167: timestamp: uint64(timestamp.UnixMilli()),
168: payload: append([]byte(nil), sample...),
169: })
170: return nil
171: }

173: // WriteAudio sends the Opus payload from the RTP packet. The RTP timestamp is
174: // mapped onto the same wall clock as video, so the browser can schedule both
175: // streams together.
176: func (o *WebSocketOutput) WriteAudio(packet _rtp.Packet, received time.Time) error {
177: if packet == nil || len(packet.Payload) == 0 {
178: return errors.New("cannot publish an empty Opus packet")
179: }
180: o.audioMu.Lock()
181: if !o.audioClockSet {
182: o.audioClockSet = true
183: o.audioBaseRTP = packet.Timestamp
184: o.audioBaseTime = received
185: }
186: delta := packet.Timestamp - o.audioBaseRTP
187: // A backwards jump means the encoder restarted its timestamp base.
188: if delta > 1<<31 {
189: o.audioBaseRTP = packet.Timestamp
190: o.audioBaseTime = received
191: delta = 0
192: }
193: timestamp := o.audioBaseTime.Add(time.Duration(delta) _ time.Second / 48000)
194: o.audioMu.Unlock()
195:
196: o.enqueue(outbound{
197: kind: relayAudio,
198: timestamp: uint64(timestamp.UnixMilli()),
199: payload: append([]byte(nil), packet.Payload...),
200: })
201: return nil
202: }

204: // Close flushes nothing (live media has no useful tail) and releases the socket.
205: func (o *WebSocketOutput) Close() error {
206: o.once.Do(func() {
207: close(o.done)
208: o.sendMu.Lock()
209: if o.conn != nil {
210: \_ = o.conn.Close()
211: o.conn = nil
212: }
213: o.sendMu.Unlock()
214: })
215: o.wg.Wait()
216: return nil
217: }

219: func (o *WebSocketOutput) enqueue(frame outbound) {
220: select {
221: case o.queue <- frame:
222: if o.dropping.Swap(false) {
223: o.log.Info("relay output caught up", "room", o.opts.Room)
224: }
225: return
226: default:
227: }
228:
229: // The socket cannot keep up. Keeping the backlog would only add latency,
230: // and sending deltas across a gap would corrupt the picture until the next
231: // keyframe anyway, so drop everything queued and resume at the next IDR.
232: // A keyframe that is being queued right now is the perfect place to resume.
233: dropped := 0
234: drain:
235: for {
236: select {
237: case <-o.queue:
238: dropped++
239: default:
240: break drain
241: }
242: }
243:
244: video := frame.kind == relayVideo
245: keyframe := video && frame.flags&relayKeyframe != 0
246: if !keyframe {
247: o.needsKeyframe.Store(true)
248: }
249: if !o.dropping.Swap(true) {
250: o.log.Warn("relay output fell behind; dropped the backlog and will resync on a keyframe",
251: "dropped", dropped, "kind", frame.kind)
252: }
253: if video && !keyframe {
254: // Dropping a delta is what keeps the decoder from showing garbage
255: // until the next IDR.
256: return
257: }
258: select {
259: case o.queue <- frame:
260: default:
261: }
262: }

264: func (o *WebSocketOutput) currentConn() *websocket.Conn {
265: o.sendMu.Lock()
266: defer o.sendMu.Unlock()
267: return o.conn
268: }

270: func (o *WebSocketOutput) setConn(conn *websocket.Conn) {
271: o.sendMu.Lock()
272: o.conn = conn
273: o.sendMu.Unlock()
274: }
275:
276: // closeConn closes and forgets the current socket, if any.
277: func (o *WebSocketOutput) closeConn() {
278: o.sendMu.Lock()
279: conn := o.conn
280: o.conn = nil
281: o.sendMu.Unlock()
282: if conn != nil {
283: \_ = conn.Close()
284: }
285: }

287: func (o *WebSocketOutput) run(ctx context.Context) {
288: defer o.wg.Done()
289: backoff := time.Second
290:
291: for {
292: if o.currentConn() == nil {
293: dialCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 10*time.Second)
294: conn, err := o.dial(dialCtx)
295: cancel()
296: if err != nil {
297: if ctx.Err() != nil {
298: return
299: }
300: o.log.Warn("relay connect failed; retrying", "error", err, "retry_in", backoff.Round(time.Millisecond))
301: if !o.sleep(ctx, backoff) {
302: return
303: }
304: backoff = min(backoff*2, 30*time.Second)
305: continue
306: }
307: o.setConn(conn)
308: o.needsKeyframe.Store(true)
309: backoff = time.Second
310: }
311:
312: err := o.writeLoop(ctx)
313: o.closeConn()
314: if ctx.Err() != nil || !o.isOpen() {
315: return
316: }
317: if err != nil {
318: o.log.Warn("relay connection lost; reconnecting", "error", err, "retry_in", backoff.Round(time.Millisecond))
319: }
320: if !o.sleep(ctx, backoff) {
321: return
322: }
323: backoff = min(backoff*2, 30*time.Second)
324: }
325: }
326:
327: // sleep waits for d, returning false when the output is shutting down.
328: func (o *WebSocketOutput) sleep(ctx context.Context, d time.Duration) bool {
329: timer := time.NewTimer(d)
330: defer timer.Stop()
331: select {
332: case <-ctx.Done():
333: return false
334: case <-o.done:
335: return false
336: case <-timer.C:
337: return true
338: }
339: }

341: func (o *WebSocketOutput) isOpen() bool {
342: select {
343: case <-o.done:
344: return false
345: default:
346: return true
347: }
348: }

350: func (o *WebSocketOutput) writeLoop(ctx context.Context) error {
351: ping := time.NewTicker(25 _ time.Second)
352: defer ping.Stop()
353: for {
354: select {
355: case <-ctx.Done():
356: return nil
357: case <-o.done:
358: return nil
359: case frame := <-o.queue:
360: o.sendMu.Lock()
361: conn := o.conn
362: if conn != nil {
363: \_ = conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(10 _ time.Second))
364: }
365: o.sendMu.Unlock()
366: if conn == nil {
367: continue
368: }
369: data := encodeRelayFrame(frame)
370: if err := conn.WriteMessage(websocket.BinaryMessage, data); err != nil {
371: return err
372: }
373: o.recordBytes(int64(len(data)))
374: case <-ping.C:
375: o.sendMu.Lock()
376: conn := o.conn
377: if conn != nil {
378: _ = conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second))
379: }
380: o.sendMu.Unlock()
381: if conn == nil {
382: continue
383: }
384: if err := conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage,
385: []byte(fmt.Sprintf(`{"v":%d,"type":"ping","t":%d}`, relayProtocolVersion, time.Now().UnixMilli()))); err != nil {
386: return err
387: }
388: }
389: }
390: }
391:
392: func (o *WebSocketOutput) recordBytes(count int64) {
393: o.bytesSinceLog += count
394: elapsed := time.Since(o.lastLog)
395: if elapsed < 10*time.Second {
396: return
397: }
398: o.log.Info("relay publisher bandwidth",
399: "room", o.opts.Room,
400: "estimated_kbps", float64(o.bytesSinceLog)*8/elapsed.Seconds()/1000,
401: )
402: o.bytesSinceLog = 0
403: o.lastLog = time.Now()
404: }

406: func (o *WebSocketOutput) dial(ctx context.Context) (*websocket.Conn, error) {
407: endpoint, err := relayPublishURL(o.opts.Endpoint, o.opts.Room)
408: if err != nil {
409: return nil, err
410: }
411: dialer := websocket.Dialer{HandshakeTimeout: 10 \* time.Second}
412: conn, response, err := dialer.DialContext(ctx, endpoint, nil)
413: if err != nil {
414: if response != nil {
415: return nil, fmt.Errorf("connect to relay (HTTP %s): %w", response.Status, err)
416: }
417: return nil, fmt.Errorf("connect to relay: %w", err)
418: }
419: hello := map[string]any{
420: "v": relayProtocolVersion, "type": "hello", "role": "publisher", "token": o.opts.Token,
421: }
422: _ = conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(10 _ time.Second))
423: if err := conn.WriteJSON(hello); err != nil {
424: * = conn.Close()
425: return nil, fmt.Errorf("send relay hello: %w", err)
426: }
427: * = conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(10 _ time.Second))
428: var ready struct {
429: Version int `json:"v"`
430: Type string `json:"type"`
431: Code string `json:"code"`
432: Message string `json:"message"`
433: }
434: if err := conn.ReadJSON(&ready); err != nil {
435: _ = conn.Close()
436: return nil, fmt.Errorf("read relay welcome: %w", err)
437: }
438: if ready.Type == "error" {
439: _ = conn.Close()
440: return nil, fmt.Errorf("relay rejected publisher (%s): %s", ready.Code, ready.Message)
441: }
442: if ready.Type != "ready" || ready.Version != relayProtocolVersion {
443: _ = conn.Close()
444: return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected relay handshake response %q", ready.Type)
445: }
446: _ = conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Time{})
447: o.log.Info("connected to relay", "room", o.opts.Room)
448: return conn, nil
449: }
450:
451: func relayPublishURL(endpoint, room string) (string, error) {
452: base, err := url.Parse(strings.TrimSpace(endpoint))
453: if err != nil {
454: return "", fmt.Errorf("parse relay URL: %w", err)
455: }
456: if (base.Scheme != "wss" && base.Scheme != "ws") || base.Host == "" {
457: return "", errors.New("relay URL must be an absolute ws or wss URL")
458: }
459: base.Path = path.Join(base.Path, "v1", "publish", room)
460: base.RawPath = ""
461: base.RawQuery = ""
462: base.Fragment = ""
463: return base.String(), nil
464: }
465:
466: func encodeRelayFrame(frame outbound) []byte {
467: data := make([]byte, relayHeaderSize+len(frame.payload))
468: data[0] = frame.kind
469: data[1] = frame.flags
470: binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(data[2:10], frame.timestamp)
471: copy(data[10:], frame.payload)
472: return data
473: }

31: // at the start of a stream; a relay that reconnects or a viewer that joins later
32: // still needs them before the IDR slice.
33: func ensureParameterSets(accessUnit []byte, info h264Info, sps, pps []byte) []byte {
34: if !info.hasIDR {
35: return accessUnit
36: }
37: var prefix []byte
38: if info.sps == nil && len(sps) > 0 {
39: prefix = append(prefix, sps...)
40: }
41: if info.pps == nil && len(pps) > 0 {
42: prefix = append(prefix, pps...)
43: }
44: if len(prefix) == 0 {
45: return accessUnit
46: }
47: return insertBeforeIDR(accessUnit, prefix)
48: }

51: // after any access-unit delimiter or SEI that must stay in front.

53: if len(prefix) == 0 {
54: return data
55: }
56: for _, part := range splitNALOffsets(data) {
57: if len(part.nal) > 0 && part.nal[0]&0x1f == 5 {
58: result := make([]byte, 0, len(data)+len(prefix))
59: result = append(result, data[:part.start]...)
60: result = append(result, prefix...)
61: result = append(result, data[part.start:]...)
62: return result
63: }
64: }
65: return data
66: }

70: for \_, part := range splitNALOffsets(data) {
71: result = append(result, part.nal)
72: }

81: func splitNALOffsets(data []byte) []nalPart {
82: var starts []int
83: var lengths []int
84: for i := 0; i+2 < len(data); {
85: switch {
86: case data[i] == 0 && data[i+1] == 0 && data[i+2] == 1:
87: starts = append(starts, i)
88: lengths = append(lengths, 3)
89: i += 3
90: case i+3 < len(data) && bytes.Equal(data[i:i+4], []byte{0, 0, 0, 1}):
91: starts = append(starts, i)
92: lengths = append(lengths, 4)
93: i += 4
94: default:
95: i++
96: }
97: }
98: parts := make([]nalPart, 0, len(starts))
99: for index, start := range starts {
100: end := len(data)
101: if index+1 < len(starts) {
102: end = starts[index+1]
103: }
104: nalStart := start + lengths[index]

177: cloudflared: opts.Relay.Cloudflared,
178: cloudflaredBin: cloudflaredBin,
179: viewerDir: strings.TrimSpace(opts.ViewerDir),
180: discordClientID: discordClientID,
181: discordSecret: discordSecret,
182: identitySecret: identitySecret,
183: workerURL: deriveWorkerURL(opts.SignalingURL),
184: workerToken: strings.TrimSpace(settings.PublishToken), // Use publishToken as fallback for Worker admin token
185: }
186: if m.publishToken == "" {
187: m.publishToken = strings.TrimSpace(opts.Relay.Token)
188: }
189:
190: gateway, relay, bot, ok := localActivityAddresses(opts.Relay.Enabled, opts.Relay.URL)
191: if ok && script == "" {
192: m.mode = "activity"
193: m.gatewayAddr = gateway
194: m.relayAddr = relay
195: m.botAddr = bot
196: m.healthAddr = healthAddr(gateway)
197: }
198: if m.healthAddr == "" {
199: m.healthAddr = fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%d", m.port)
200: }
201: return m
202: }

204: // deriveWorkerURL converts the signaling WebSocket URL to the Worker HTTP URL.
205: // e.g., wss://streamy-signal.thenightserver.workers.dev -> https://streamy-signal.thenightserver.workers.dev
206: func deriveWorkerURL(signalingURL string) string {
207: u, err := url.Parse(signalingURL)
208: if err != nil {
209: return ""
210: }
211: if u.Scheme == "wss" {
212: u.Scheme = "https"
213: return u.String()
214: }
215: if u.Scheme == "ws" {
216: u.Scheme = "http"
217: return u.String()
218: }
219: return signalingURL
220: }

222: // defaultActivityScript finds the packaged Activity launcher beside the app.
223: // A development checkout normally sets stack.script explicitly; an installed
224: // build ships stack\start-stack.ps1, and this makes it work without requiring
225: // the user to edit config.json.
226: func defaultActivityScript() string {
227: self, err := os.Executable()
228: if err != nil {
229: return ""
230: }
231: candidates := []string{
232: filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(self), "stack", "start-stack.ps1"),
233: filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(self), "start-stack.ps1"),
234: }
235: for *, candidate := range candidates {
236: if info, err := os.Stat(candidate); err == nil && !info.IsDir() {
237: return candidate
238: }
239: }
240: return ""
241: }

243: // readDiscordClientIDFromViewerConfig reads the discordClientID from the viewer's config.json.
244: func readDiscordClientIDFromViewerConfig(viewerDir string) string {
245: // Try dist/config.json first (built), then public/config.json (source)
246: for *, name := range []string{"dist/config.json", "public/config.json"} {
247: path := filepath.Join(viewerDir, name)
248: data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
249: if err != nil {
250: continue
251: }
252: var cfg struct {
253: DiscordClientID string `json:"discordClientID"`
254: }
255: if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &cfg); err != nil {
256: continue
257: }
258: if cfg.DiscordClientID != "" {
259: return cfg.DiscordClientID
260: }
261: }
262: return ""
263: }

265: // generateIdentitySecret generates a random 32-byte secret encoded as base64.
266: func generateIdentitySecret() string {
267: bytes := make([]byte, 32)
268: if *, err := rand.Read(bytes); err != nil {
269: // Fallback to a time-based seed if crypto/rand fails
270: return fmt.Sprintf("streamy-identity-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
271: }
272: return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(bytes)
273: }

275: // saveIdentitySecret saves the identity secret to a file in the log directory for persistence.
276: func saveIdentitySecret(logDir, secret string, logger *slog.Logger) {
277: if logDir == "" {

279: }
280: secretDir := filepath.Join(logDir, "stack")
281: if err := os.MkdirAll(secretDir, 0o755); err != nil {
282: return

285: if err := os.WriteFile(secretPath, []byte(secret), 0o600); err != nil {

309: // Start launches the child in the background. It is safe to call repeatedly.
310: func (m *Manager) Start() {
311: m.mu.Lock()
312: if m.started {
313: m.mu.Unlock()
314: return
315: }
316: m.started = true
317: m.generation++
318: generation := m.generation
319: script := m.script
320: m.mu.Unlock()
321:
322: if script != "" {
323: if info, err := os.Stat(script); err == nil && !info.IsDir() {
324: m.logger.Info("starting the local stack from a script", "script", script)
325: go m.runScript(script, generation)
326: return
327: }
328: m.logger.Warn("configured stack script was not found; using the built-in stack", "script", script)
329: }
330:
331: // A previous Streamy process may have left the stack running. Adopt it
332: // instead of fighting over the port.
333: if m.healthOK() {
334: m.mu.Lock()
335: if generation == m.generation {
336: m.running = true
337: m.owned = false
338: m.err = nil
339: }
340: m.mu.Unlock()
341: m.logger.Info(m.label()+" is already running", "health", m.healthAddr)
342: return
343: }
344:
345: ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
346: done := make(chan struct{})
347: m.mu.Lock()
348: if generation != m.generation {
349: m.mu.Unlock()
350: cancel()
351: return
352: }
353: m.cancel = cancel
354: m.procDone = done
355: m.owned = true
356: m.mu.Unlock()
357:
358: if m.mode == "activity" {
359: m.logger.Info("starting the local Activity stack",
360: "gateway", m.gatewayAddr, "relay", m.relayAddr, "bot", m.botAddr)
361: go m.runChild(ctx, done, generation, m.activityArgs(), m.label())
362: return
363: }
364: go m.runChild(ctx, done, generation,
365: []string{"bot", "-port", strconv.Itoa(m.port)}, m.label())
366: }
367:
368: // Running reports whether the child is answering its health endpoint. The idle
369: // watchdog uses it to decide whether there is anything to stop.
370: func (m *Manager) Running() bool {
371: m.mu.Lock()
372: defer m.mu.Unlock()
373: return m.running
374: }
375:
376: // Stop shuts the child down. A child started by this process is killed; an
377: // adopted notification bot is asked to exit gracefully. An adopted Activity
378: // stack is left alone because it has no quit endpoint and somebody else owns
379: // its lifetime.
380: func (m *Manager) Stop(ctx context.Context) error {
381: m.mu.Lock()
382: started := m.started
383: script := m.script
384: cancel := m.cancel
385: done := m.procDone
386: owned := m.owned
387: mode := m.mode
388: m.started = false
389: m.running = false
390: m.owned = false
391: m.cancel = nil
392: m.procDone = nil
393: m.generation++
394: m.mu.Unlock()
395:
396: if !started {
397: return nil
398: }
399:
400: if script != "" {
401: if info, err := os.Stat(script); err == nil && !info.IsDir() {
402: if cancel != nil {
403: cancel()
404: }
405: m.logger.Info("stopping the local stack")
406: runCtx, stopCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 20*time.Second)
407: defer stopCancel()
408: args := []string{"-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File", script, "-Stop"}
409: if err := m.exec(runCtx, args...); err != nil {
410: return fmt.Errorf("stop local stack: %w", err)
411: }
412: return nil
413: }
414: }
415:
416: if mode == "activity" && !owned {
417: m.logger.Info("the Activity stack was started outside Streamy; leaving it running")
418: return nil
419: }
420:
421: m.logger.Info("stopping " + m.label())
422: if mode == "bot" {
423: m.requestQuit(ctx)
424: }
425: if cancel != nil {
426: cancel()
427: }
428: if done != nil {
429: select {
430: case <-done:
431: case <-ctx.Done():
432: case <-time.After(stopTimeout):
433: m.logger.Warn(m.label() + " did not stop in time")
434: }
435: }
436: return nil
437: }
438:
439: // runChild starts args as a child of this executable and waits until its health
440: // endpoint answers. It is shared by the notification bot and the Activity
441: // stack so both get the same crash handling and startup timeout.
442: func (m *Manager) runChild(ctx context.Context, done chan struct{}, generation int, args []string, label string) {
443: defer close(done)
444:
445: self, err := m.self()
446: if err != nil {
447: m.finish(generation, err, false)
448: return
449: }
450: cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, self, args...)
451: cmd.Dir = filepath.Dir(self)
452: executil.HideConsoleWindow(cmd)
453:
454: // Pass Discord credentials as environment variables (activity command reads from env as fallback)
455: if m.discordClientID != "" {
456: cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env, "DISCORD_CLIENT_ID="+m.discordClientID)
457: }
458: if m.discordSecret != "" {
459: cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env, "DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET="+m.discordSecret)
460: }
461: if m.identitySecret != "" {
462: cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env, "DISCORD_IDENTITY_SECRET="+m.identitySecret)
463: }
464: // Also pass publish token for the relay
465: if m.publishToken != "" {
466: cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env, "DISCORD_PUBLISH_TOKEN="+m.publishToken)
467: }
468:
469: if logFile := m.openLog(); logFile != nil {
470: cmd.Stdout = logFile
471: cmd.Stderr = logFile
472: defer logFile.Close()
473: }
474: if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
475: m.finish(generation, err, false)
476: return
477: }
478:
479: waitCh := make(chan error, 1)
480: go func() { waitCh <- cmd.Wait() }()
481:
482: deadline := time.Now().Add(startupTimeout)
483: ticker := time.NewTicker(250 * time.Millisecond)
484: defer ticker.Stop()
485: for {
486: select {
487: case err := <-waitCh:
488: // The child exited before it became healthy: a bad token, a port
489: // already in use, or a missing .env.
490: if err != nil {
491: m.logger.Warn(label+" exited during startup", "error", err)
492: }
493: m.finish(generation, err, false)
494: return
495: case <-ctx.Done():
496: * = cmd.Process.Kill()
497: <-waitCh
498: m.finish(generation, ctx.Err(), false)
499: return
500: case <-ticker.C:
501: if m.healthOK() {
502: m.mu.Lock()
503: if generation == m.generation {
504: m.running = true
505: m.err = nil
506: }
507: m.mu.Unlock()
508: m.logger.Info(label+" is ready", "health", m.healthAddr)
509:
510: err := <-waitCh
511: if err != nil && ctx.Err() == nil {
512: m.logger.Warn(label+" exited", "error", err)
513: }
514: m.finish(generation, err, false)
515: return
516: }
517: if time.Now().After(deadline) {
518: _ = cmd.Process.Kill()
519: <-waitCh
520: m.finish(generation, fmt.Errorf("%s did not become healthy on %s", label, m.healthAddr), false)
521: return
522: }
523: }
524: }
525: }
526:
527: func (m *Manager) runScript(script string, generation int) {
528: ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 3*time.Minute)
529: m.mu.Lock()
530: if generation != m.generation {
531: m.mu.Unlock()
532: cancel()
533: return
534: }
535: m.cancel = cancel
536: m.mu.Unlock()
537: defer cancel()
538:
539: args := []string{"-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File", script, "-Hidden"}
540: if m.publishToken != "" {
541: args = append(args, "-PublishToken", m.publishToken)
542: }
543: err := m.exec(ctx, args...)
544: m.finish(generation, err, err == nil)
545: if err != nil {
546: m.logger.Warn("the local stack did not start", "error", err)
547: return
548: }
549: m.logger.Info("the local stack is ready")
550: }
551:
552: func (m *Manager) finish(generation int, err error, running bool) {
553: m.mu.Lock()
554: defer m.mu.Unlock()
555: if generation != m.generation {
556: return
557: }
558: m.running = running
559: m.err = err
560: if !running {
561: // The child is gone. Clear started so the next Start (for example when
562: // the user begins a new stream) relaunches it instead of leaving the
563: // manager stuck after a failed startup or a crash.
564: m.started = false
565: m.owned = false
566: }
567: }
568:
569: func (m *Manager) exec(ctx context.Context, args ...string) error {
570: cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "powershell.exe", args...)
571: executil.HideConsoleWindow(cmd)
572: output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
573: if err != nil {
574: text := strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
575: if text != "" {
576: return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", err, tail(text, 800))
577: }
578: return err
579: }
580: return nil
581: }

583: func (m *Manager) healthOK() bool {
584: client := http.Client{Timeout: 2 * time.Second}
585: response, err := client.Get("http://" + m.healthAddr + "/healthz")
586: if err != nil {
587: return false
588: }
589: defer response.Body.Close()
590: _, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, response.Body)
591: return response.StatusCode >= 200 && response.StatusCode < 300
592: }
593:
594: func (m *Manager) requestQuit(ctx context.Context) {
595: if m.apiKey == "" {
596: return
597: }
598: quitCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 2*time.Second)
599: defer cancel()
600: request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(quitCtx, http.MethodPost,
601: fmt.Sprintf("http://127.0.0.1:%d/api/quit", m.port), nil)
602: if err != nil {
603: return
604: }
605: request.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+m.apiKey)
606: client := http.Client{Timeout: 2 * time.Second}
607: response, err := client.Do(request)
608: if err != nil {
609: return
610: }
611: response.Body.Close()
612: }

614: // self returns the executable that hosts the bot and activity subcommands.
615: func (m *Manager) self() (string, error) {
616: if m.executable != "" {
617: return m.executable, nil
618: }
619: return os.Executable()
620: }

622: // activityArgs builds the `streamy activity` command line. The publish token is
623: // the relay's publisher secret (stream.stack.publishToken wins over
624: // stream.relay.token); the addresses were derived from stream.relay.url.
625: func (m *Manager) activityArgs() []string {
626: args := []string{
627: "activity",
628: "-gateway", m.gatewayAddr,
629: "-relay", m.relayAddr,
630: "-bot", m.botAddr,
631: }
632: if m.publishToken != "" {
633: args = append(args, "-publish-token", m.publishToken)
634: }
635: if m.maxViewers > 0 {
636: args = append(args, "-max-viewers", strconv.Itoa(m.maxViewers))
637: }
638: if m.logLevel != "" {
639: args = append(args, "-log-level", m.logLevel)
640: }
641: if m.cloudflared {
642: args = append(args, "-cloudflared")
643: if m.cloudflaredBin != "" {
644: args = append(args, "-cloudflared-bin", m.cloudflaredBin)
645: }
646: }
647: if m.viewerDir != "" {
648: args = append(args, "-viewer-dir", m.viewerDir)
649: }
650: // Worker front door for tunnel publishing
651: if m.workerURL != "" {
652: args = append(args, "-worker-url", m.workerURL)
653: }
654: if m.workerToken != "" {
655: args = append(args, "-worker-token", m.workerToken)
656: }
657: // Discord OAuth credentials for Activity
658: if m.discordClientID != "" {
659: args = append(args, "-discord-client", m.discordClientID)
660: }
661: if m.discordSecret != "" {
662: args = append(args, "-discord-secret", m.discordSecret)
663: }
664: if m.identitySecret != "" {
665: args = append(args, "-identity-secret", m.identitySecret)
666: }
667: return args
668: }

671: if m.mode == "activity" {
672: return "the local Activity stack"
673: }
674: return "the local Discord bot"

677: func (m *Manager) openLog() *os.File {
678: dir := ""
679: if m.logDir != "" {
680: dir = filepath.Join(m.logDir, "stack")
681: } else {
682: self, err := m.self()
683: if err != nil {
684: return nil
685: }
686: dir = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(self), "stack", ".run")
687: }
688: if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
689: return nil
690: }
691: name := "bot.log"
692: if m.mode == "activity" {
693: name = "activity.log"
694: }
695: file, err := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(dir, name), os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0o600)
696: if err != nil {
697: return nil
698: }
699: return file
700: }
701:
702: // localActivityAddresses decides whether the built-in Activity stack should run
703: // for this relay URL and, if so, which ports it should use. Only a plain ws URL
704: // on a loopback host can be served by the built-in plain-WebSocket stack; a
705: // remote or TLS relay is somebody else's deployment and must not spawn one.
706: //
707: // The port in the URL tells us which service the desktop app publishes to:
708: // ws://127.0.0.1:8080/.proxy/relay goes through the gateway, while
709: // ws://127.0.0.1:8081 talks to the relay directly.
710: func localActivityAddresses(enabled bool, raw string) (gateway, relay, bot string, ok bool) {
711: if !enabled {
712: return "", "", "", false
713: }
714: parsed, err := url.Parse(strings.TrimSpace(raw))
715: if err != nil || parsed.Scheme != "ws" {
716: return "", "", "", false
717: }
718: switch strings.ToLower(parsed.Hostname()) {
719: case "127.0.0.1", "localhost", "::1":
720: default:
721: return "", "", "", false
722: }
723: portNumber, err := strconv.Atoi(parsed.Port())
724: if err != nil || portNumber < 1 || portNumber > 65535 {
725: return "", "", "", false
726: }
727:
728: used := map[int]bool{}
729: var gatewayPort, relayPort, botPort int
730: if strings.Contains(parsed.Path, "/.proxy/relay") {
731: gatewayPort = portNumber
732: used[gatewayPort] = true
733: relayPort = firstFreePort(used, defaultRelayPort, 18081)
734: botPort = firstFreePort(used, defaultActivityBotPort, 18083)
735: } else {
736: relayPort = portNumber
737: used[relayPort] = true
738: gatewayPort = firstFreePort(used, defaultGatewayPort, 18080)
739: botPort = firstFreePort(used, defaultActivityBotPort, 18083)
740: }
741: return fmt.Sprintf(":%d", gatewayPort),
742: fmt.Sprintf(":%d", relayPort),
743: fmt.Sprintf(":%d", botPort),
744: true
745: }
746:
747: // firstFreePort returns the first candidate port that is not already assigned
748: // to another service. The fallback list is deliberately short and predictable;
749: // a busy port still fails fast inside `streamy activity` with a clear error.
750: func firstFreePort(used map[int]bool, candidates ...int) int {
751: for _, port := range candidates {
752: if !used[port] {
753: used[port] = true
754: return port
755: }
756: }
757: for port := 28080; ; port++ {
758: if !used[port] {
759: used[port] = true
760: return port
761: }
762: }
763: }
764:
765: // healthAddr turns a listen address into one that can be dialled locally.
766: func healthAddr(listen string) string {
767: host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(listen)
768: if err != nil {
769: return "127.0.0.1" + listen
770: }
771: switch host {
772: case "", "::", "0.0.0.0":
773: host = "127.0.0.1"
774: }
775: return net.JoinHostPort(host, port)
776: }
777:
778: func portFromNotifyURL(raw string) int {
779: if strings.TrimSpace(raw) == "" {
780: return defaultBotPort
781: }
782: parsed, err := url.Parse(raw)
783: if err != nil {
784: return defaultBotPort
785: }
786: if value := parsed.Port(); value != "" {
787: if port, err := strconv.Atoi(value); err == nil && port > 0 && port < 65536 {
788: return port
789: }
790: }
791: return defaultBotPort
792: }
793:
794: func tail(text string, max int) string {
795: if len(text) <= max {
796: return text
797: }
798: return text[len(text)-max:]
799: }

64: os.Exit(1)
65: }
66: }

68: func run() error {
69: // Enabling per monitor DPI awareness has to happen before this process
70: // creates its first window, and the tray icon is a window. Without it
71: // Windows reports scaled-down coordinates for every window rectangle, and
72: // the fullscreen detection would be wrong on any display that is not at
73: // 100%.
74: capture.EnableDPIAwareness()
75:
76: var (
77: configPath = flag.String("config", "", "path to config.json (default: the user config directory)")
78: headless = flag.Bool("headless", false, "run without a tray icon (for debugging)")
79: showVersion = flag.Bool("version", false, "print the version and exit")
80: logLevel = flag.String("log-level", "", "override the configured log level (debug|info|warn|error)")
81: outputDir = flag.String("output-dir", "", "where recordings are written when -record-only is set")
82: recordOnly = flag.Bool("record-only", false, "record to MP4 instead of sharing to a browser")
83: noCapture = flag.Bool("no-capture", false, "run with no streaming pipeline, to exercise the tray only")
84: )
85: flag.Parse()
86:
87: if *showVersion {
88: fmt.Println("streamy", version.String())
89: return nil
90: }
91:
92: // 1. Find the config file. DefaultPath is the platform's user config
93: // directory: %AppData%\streamy on Windows.
94: cfgPath := *configPath
95: if cfgPath == "" {
96: p, err := config.DefaultPath()
97: if err != nil {
98: return err
99: }
100: cfgPath = p
101: }
102:
103: // 2. Load it. A missing file is created from the defaults, which is why the
104: // very first run just works.
105: cfg, created, err := config.LoadFrom(cfgPath)
106: if err != nil {
107: return err
108: }
109: if *logLevel != "" {
110: cfg.LogLevel = *logLevel
111: }
112:
113: // 3. Start logging as early as possible so everything after this point is
114: // recorded, and keep the file open until the process exits.
115: logger, closeLog, err := logging.Setup(logging.Options{
116: Level: cfg.LogLevel,
117: File: filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(cfgPath), "streamy.log"),
118: })
119: if err != nil {
120: return err
121: }
122: defer func() {
123: if err := closeLog(); err != nil {
124: fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "streamy: closing log:", err)
125: }
126: }()
127: // Setting the default means third party code that logs with slog.Default()
128: // (the systray library, for one) also lands in our file.
129: slog.SetDefault(logger)
130:
131: if created {
132: logger.Info("created a default config", "path", cfgPath)
133: }
134: logger.Info("starting", "version", version.String(), "config", cfgPath, "logLevel", cfg.LogLevel)
135:
136: // 4. Two trays would fight over the same hotkey, so only one may run.
137: release, ok := singleinstance.Acquire()
138: if !ok {
139: logger.Warn("another Streamy instance is already running, exiting")
140: fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "streamy: another instance is already running (look in the notification area)")
141: return nil
142: }
143: defer release()
144:
145: // 5. Ctrl+C in a terminal cancels ctx, which closes the tray and stops the
146: // pipeline in an orderly way.
147: ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
148: defer stop()
149:
150: // 6. Build the live WebRTC pipeline. Recording remains available as an
151: // explicit diagnostic mode; both implementations share pipeline.Streamer.
152: var streamer pipeline.Streamer
153: if !*noCapture {
154: if *recordOnly {
155: streamer = pipeline.NewRecorder(pipeline.Options{Logger: logger, OutputDir: *outputDir})
156: } else {
157: streamer = pipeline.NewLiveStreamer(logger)
158: }
159: }
160:
161: // 7. Build and run. Run does not return until the tray is closed, and it
162: // always runs the shutdown path before returning.
163: application, err := app.New(app.Options{
164: Logger: logger,
165: Config: cfg,
166: ConfigPath: cfgPath,
167: Streamer: streamer,
168: Headless: *headless,
169: })
170: if err != nil {
171: return err
172: }
173:
174: if err := application.Run(ctx); err != nil {
175: return err
176: }
177: logger.Info("bye")
178: return nil
179: }

181: func runActivity(args []string) error {
182: fs := flag.NewFlagSet("activity", flag.ExitOnError)
183: var (
184: gatewayAddr = fs.String("gateway", ":8080", "gateway listen address")
185: relayAddr = fs.String("relay", ":8081", "relay listen address")
186: botAddr = fs.String("bot", ":8083", "bot listen address")
187: viewerDir = fs.String("viewer-dir", "", "directory containing viewer static files (empty = embedded)")
188: publicHost = fs.String("public-host", "", "public hostname for tunnel (default: gateway host)")
189: identitySecret = fs.String("identity-secret", os.Getenv("DISCORD*IDENTITY_SECRET"), "HMAC secret for identity tokens (min 32 chars)")
190: discordClient = fs.String("discord-client", os.Getenv("DISCORD_CLIENT_ID"), "Discord OAuth client ID")
191: discordSecret = fs.String("discord-secret", os.Getenv("DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET"), "Discord OAuth client secret")
192: publishToken = fs.String("publish-token", os.Getenv("DISCORD_PUBLISH_TOKEN"), "token required for publishers")
193: maxViewers = fs.Int("max-viewers", 200, "maximum viewers per room")
194: logLevel = fs.String("log-level", "info", "log level (debug|info|warn|error)")
195: version = fs.Bool("version", false, "print version and exit")
196: // Cloudflare tunnel options
197: cloudflared = fs.Bool("cloudflared", false, "start cloudflared tunnel to gateway")
198: cfBin = fs.String("cloudflared-bin", "cloudflared", "cloudflared binary path or name")
199: cfArgs = fs.String("cloudflared-args", "", "extra arguments for cloudflared (e.g., '--no-autoupdate')")
200: // Worker front door options (for publishing tunnel URL)
201: workerURL = fs.String("worker-url", "", "Worker front door URL (e.g., https://streamy-signal.thenightserver.workers.dev)")
202: workerToken = fs.String("worker-token", "", "Worker admin token for tunnel publishing (TUNNEL_ADMIN_TOKEN)")
203: )
204: fs.Parse(args)
205:
206: if *version {
207: fmt.Println("streamy-activity 0.1.0")
208: return nil
209: }
210:
211: var level slog.Level
212: switch *logLevel {
213: case "debug":
214: level = slog.LevelDebug
215: case "info":
216: level = slog.LevelInfo
217: case "warn":
218: level = slog.LevelWarn
219: case "error":
220: level = slog.LevelError
221: default:
222: return fmt.Errorf("invalid log level: %s", *logLevel)
223: }
224: logger := slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(os.Stderr, &slog.HandlerOptions{Level: level}))
225: slog.SetDefault(logger)
226:
227: // Discord sign-in is optional. Validate the signing key only when one was
228: // supplied, so `streamy activity` can run the relay, gateway and lobby on a
229: // machine that has no Discord application configured.
230: if *identitySecret != "" {
231: if *, err := identity.SigningKey(*identitySecret); err != nil {
232: return fmt.Errorf("invalid identity secret: %w", err)
233: }
234: }
235: if *discordClient == "" || *discordSecret == "" || *identitySecret == "" {
236: logger.Warn("Discord sign-in is disabled; set DISCORD*CLIENT_ID, DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET and DISCORD_IDENTITY_SECRET to enable /api/auth/*")
237: }
238:
239: botCfg := bot.Config{
240: DiscordClientID: *discordClient,
241: DiscordClientSecret: *discordSecret,
242: IdentitySecret: *identitySecret,
243: PublishToken: *publishToken,
244: RelayAddr: *relayAddr,
245: GatewayAddr: *gatewayAddr,
246: BotAddr: *botAddr,
247: PublicHost: *publicHost,
248: MaxViewers: *maxViewers,
249: ICEServers: []string{"stun:stun.l.google.com:19302"},
250: }
251:
252: botSrv, err := bot.NewBot(logger, botCfg)
253: if err != nil {
254: return fmt.Errorf("create bot: %w", err)
255: }
256:
257: relaySrv := relay.NewServer(logger, *publishToken, *maxViewers)
258: gatewaySrv := gateway.NewGateway(logger, botSrv, relaySrv, *viewerDir)
259:
260: ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
261: defer stop()
262:
263: // Start cloudflared tunnel if requested
264: var cfCancel context.CancelFunc
265: if *cloudflared {
266: ctx, cfCancel = context.WithCancel(ctx)
267: go func() {
268: if err := runCloudflared(ctx, logger, *cfBin, *cfArgs, *gatewayAddr, botSrv, *workerURL, *workerToken, *publishToken); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
269: logger.Error("cloudflared stopped", "error", err)
270: }
271: }()
272: // Give cloudflared a moment to establish the tunnel
273: time.Sleep(2 * time.Second)
274: }
275:
276: // Ensure cfCancel is called on all exit paths
277: if cfCancel != nil {
278: defer cfCancel()
279: }
280:
281: // Bind every port before serving. A busy default port used to leave the
282: // stack half-up (the gateway answering 502 for the bot), and nothing in the
283: // log said which piece had failed.
284: relayListener, err := net.Listen("tcp", *relayAddr)
285: if err != nil {
286: return fmt.Errorf("relay listen %s: %w", *relayAddr, err)
287: }
288: defer relayListener.Close()
289: botListener, err := net.Listen("tcp", *botAddr)
290: if err != nil {
291: return fmt.Errorf("bot listen %s: %w", *botAddr, err)
292: }
293: defer botListener.Close()
294: gatewayListener, err := net.Listen("tcp", *gatewayAddr)
295: if err != nil {
296: return fmt.Errorf("gateway listen %s: %w", *gatewayAddr, err)
297: }
298: defer gatewayListener.Close()
299:
300: go func() {
301: if err := relaySrv.Serve(ctx, relayListener); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
302: logger.Error("relay stopped", "error", err)
303: }
304: }()
305: if err := waitForAddr(ctx, relaySrv.Addr, "relay"); err != nil {
306: return err
307: }
308:
309: go func() {
310: if err := botSrv.Serve(ctx, botListener); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
311: logger.Error("bot stopped", "error", err)
312: }
313: }()
314: if err := waitForAddr(ctx, botSrv.Addr, "bot"); err != nil {
315: return err
316: }
317:
318: // The gateway resolves the relay and bot URLs from their published
319: // addresses, so it must start after both.
320: if err := gatewaySrv.Serve(ctx, gatewayListener); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
321: logger.Error("gateway stopped", "error", err)
322: return err
323: }
324:
325: logger.Info("all activity services stopped")
326: return nil
327: }
328:
329: // waitForAddr waits until a server has published its listening address (Serve
330: // sets it before it starts accepting).
331: func waitForAddr(ctx context.Context, addr func() string, name string) error {
332: deadline := time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second)
333: for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
334: if addr() != "" {
335: return nil
336: }
337: select {
338: case <-ctx.Done():
339: return ctx.Err()
340: case <-time.After(10 * time.Millisecond):
341: }
342: }
343: return fmt.Errorf("%s did not start listening in time", name)
344: }
345:
346: // runCloudflared starts cloudflared tunnel pointing to the gateway,
347: // parses the tunnel URL from stdout, registers it with the bot, and
348: // publishes it to the Worker front door.
349: func runCloudflared(ctx context.Context, logger *slog.Logger, bin, extraArgs, gatewayAddr string, botSrv \*bot.Bot, workerURL, workerToken, publishToken string) error {
350: // Parse gateway address to get port
351: *, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(gatewayAddr)
352: if err != nil {
353: return fmt.Errorf("invalid gateway address %q: %w", gatewayAddr, err)
354: }
355:
356: // Build cloudflared command
357: args := []string{"tunnel", "--url", "http://localhost:" + port, "--no-autoupdate"}
358: if extraArgs != "" {
359: // Simple split on spaces - good enough for our use case
360: for \_, arg := range splitArgs(extraArgs) {
361: args = append(args, arg)
362: }
363: }
364:
365: cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, bin, args...)
366: cmd.Stdout = nil // We'll capture via pipe
367: cmd.Stderr = nil
368:
369: stdout, err := cmd.StdoutPipe()
370: if err != nil {
371: return fmt.Errorf("stdout pipe: %w", err)
372: }
373: stderr, err := cmd.StderrPipe()
374: if err != nil {
375: return fmt.Errorf("stderr pipe: %w", err)
376: }
377:
378: if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
379: return fmt.Errorf("start cloudflared: %w", err)
380: }
381:
382: logger.Info("cloudflared started", "bin", bin, "url", "http://localhost:"+port)
383:
384: // Regex to match cloudflared tunnel URL: https://<subdomain>.trycloudflare.com
385: // or https://<subdomain>.cloudflareaccess.com (for named tunnels)
386: urlRegex := regexp.MustCompile(`https://[a-zA-Z0-9\-]+\.(trycloudflare\.com|cloudflareaccess\.com)`)
387:
388: // Determine Worker URL and token for tunnel publishing
389: adminToken := workerToken
390: if adminToken == "" {
391: adminToken = publishToken
392: }
393: logger.Info("cloudflared worker config", "workerURL", workerURL, "hasAdminToken", adminToken != "")
394:
395: tunnelPublished := false
396: var publishMu sync.Mutex
397:
398: // Read stdout and stderr to find the tunnel URL
399: // Use separate goroutines for each pipe to avoid Windows pipe blocking issues
400: done := make(chan struct{})
401: scanPipe := func(pipe io.Reader, name string) {
402: scanner := bufio.NewScanner(pipe)
403: for scanner.Scan() {
404: line := scanner.Text()
405: logger.Info("cloudflared output", "stream", name, "line", line)
406: if matches := urlRegex.FindStringSubmatch(line); len(matches) > 0 {
407: tunnelURL := matches[0]
408: host := strings.TrimPrefix(tunnelURL, "https://")
409: logger.Info("cloudflared tunnel ready", "url", tunnelURL)
410: if err := botSrv.SetTunnelURL(host); err != nil {
411: logger.Error("failed to register tunnel with bot", "error", err)
412: }
413: publishMu.Lock()
414: if !tunnelPublished && workerURL != "" && adminToken != "" {
415: if err := publishTunnelToWorker(ctx, logger, workerURL, adminToken, host); err != nil {
416: logger.Error("failed to publish tunnel to Worker", "error", err)
417: } else {
418: logger.Info("tunnel published to Worker", "url", tunnelURL)
419: tunnelPublished = true
420: }
421: }
422: publishMu.Unlock()
423: }
424: }
425: if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
426: logger.Error("cloudflared output scanner error", "stream", name, "error", err)
427: }
428: }
429:
430: go func() {
431: defer close(done)
432: logger.Info("cloudflared output scanner started")
433: var wg sync.WaitGroup
434: wg.Add(2)
435: go func() {
436: defer wg.Done()
437: scanPipe(stdout, "stdout")
438: }()
439: go func() {
440: defer wg.Done()
441: scanPipe(stderr, "stderr")
442: }()
443: wg.Wait()
444: logger.Info("cloudflared output scanner finished")
445: }()
446:
447: // Wait for command to finish
448: err = cmd.Wait()
449: <-done
450:
451: // Clean up tunnel registration on exit
452: botSrv.DeleteTunnel()
453:
454: // Also clear tunnel from Worker on exit
455: if workerURL != "" && adminToken != "" {
456: if err := deleteTunnelFromWorker(ctx, logger, workerURL, adminToken); err != nil {
457: logger.Error("failed to delete tunnel from Worker", "error", err)
458: } else {
459: logger.Info("tunnel cleared from Worker")
460: }
461: }
462:
463: return err
464: }
465:
466: // publishTunnelToWorker publishes the tunnel hostname to the Worker front door.
467: func publishTunnelToWorker(ctx context.Context, logger _slog.Logger, workerURL, token, host string) error {
468: url := strings.TrimSuffix(workerURL, "/") + "/\_\_tunnel"
469: body := fmt.Sprintf(`{"host":"%s"}`, host)
470: req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "PUT", url, strings.NewReader(body))
471: if err != nil {
472: return fmt.Errorf("create request: %w", err)
473: }
474: req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
475: req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
476:
477: client := &http.Client{Timeout: 10 _ time.Second}
478: resp, err := client.Do(req)
479: if err != nil {
480: return fmt.Errorf("request failed: %w", err)
481: }
482: defer resp.Body.Close()
483:
484: if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
485: return fmt.Errorf("worker returned status %d", resp.StatusCode)
486: }
487: return nil
488: }
489:
490: // deleteTunnelFromWorker deletes the tunnel hostname from the Worker front door.
491: func deleteTunnelFromWorker(ctx context.Context, logger _slog.Logger, workerURL, token string) error {
492: url := strings.TrimSuffix(workerURL, "/") + "/\_\_tunnel"
493: req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "DELETE", url, nil)
494: if err != nil {
495: return fmt.Errorf("create request: %w", err)
496: }
497: req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
498:
499: client := &http.Client{Timeout: 10 _ time.Second}
500: resp, err := client.Do(req)
501: if err != nil {
502: return fmt.Errorf("request failed: %w", err)
503: }
504: defer resp.Body.Close()
505:
506: if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
507: return fmt.Errorf("worker returned status %d", resp.StatusCode)
508: }
509: return nil
510: }
511:
512: // splitArgs splits a string on spaces, respecting quoted strings.
513: func splitArgs(s string) []string {
514: var args []string
515: var current strings.Builder
516: inQuote := false
517: quoteChar := byte(0)
518: for i := 0; i < len(s); i++ {
519: c := s[i]
520: if (c == '"' || c == '\'') && !inQuote {
521: inQuote = true
522: quoteChar = c
523: } else if c == quoteChar && inQuote {
524: inQuote = false
525: quoteChar = 0
526: } else if c == ' ' && !inQuote {
527: if current.Len() > 0 {
528: args = append(args, current.String())
529: current.Reset()
530: }
531: } else {
532: current.WriteByte(c)
533: }
534: }
535: if current.Len() > 0 {
536: args = append(args, current.String())
537: }
538: return args
539: }

17: "bytes"
18: "encoding/json"
19: "errors"
20: "fmt"
21: "net/url"
22: "os"
23: "path/filepath"
24: "regexp"
25: "strconv"
26: "strings"
27:
28: "streamy/internal/hotkey"
29: )
30:
31: // CurrentSchema is stored in the file so a future version can recognise configs
32: // written by an older one.
33: const CurrentSchema = 3
34:
35: // AppDirName is the folder created inside the operating system's config
36: // directory. On Windows that is %AppData%\streamy.
37: const AppDirName = "streamy"
38:
39: const (
40: DefaultSignalingURL = "wss://streamy-signal.thenightserver.workers.dev"
41: DefaultViewerURL = "https://streamy-viewer.pages.dev/"
42: )
43:
44: // legacyViewerHost is the branch alias the viewer used before production
45: // deployments moved to the project's stable pages.dev domain. Cloudflare pins
46: // a branch alias to the first preview deployment on that branch, so the alias
47: // keeps serving an old build and must not be handed out any more.
48: const legacyViewerHost = "master.streamy-viewer.pages.dev"
49:
50: // The values accepted by Capture.DefaultTarget.
51: const (
52: TargetPrimary = "primary" // the primary monitor
53: TargetFocused = "focused" // whatever window currently has focus
54: TargetMonitor = "monitor" // the monitor at Capture.MonitorIndex
55: )
56:
57: // The values accepted by Encoding.Encoder.
58: const (
59: EncoderAuto = "auto" // detect the best available encoder
60: EncoderNVENC = "nvenc"
61: EncoderQSV = "qsv"
62: EncoderAMF = "amf"
63: EncoderX264 = "x264" // software fallback
64: )
65:
66: // Config is the whole settings tree. Every field has a json tag so the file is
67: // readable and hand-editable.
68: type Config struct {
69: Schema int `json:"schema"`
70:
71: LogLevel string `json:"logLevel"`
72: SetupComplete bool `json:"setupComplete"`
73: RunAtStartup bool `json:"runAtStartup"`
74:
75: Hotkey Hotkey `json:"hotkey"`
76: Capture Capture `json:"capture"`
77: Indicator Indicator `json:"indicator"`
78: Encoding Encoding `json:"encoding"`
79: Stream Stream `json:"stream"`
80: Signaling Signaling `json:"signaling"`
81: Update Update `json:"update"`
82: }
83:
84: // Hotkey holds the global shortcuts. Both are parsed by internal/hotkey, e.g.
85: // "Ctrl+Shift+F9".
86: type Hotkey struct {
87: Enabled bool `json:"enabled"`
88: // Toggle starts a stream when idle and stops it when streaming.
89: Toggle string `json:"toggle"`
90: // Picker always opens the screen/window picker (phase 6).
91: Picker string `json:"picker"`
92: }
93:
94: // The values accepted by Indicator.Position.
95: const (
96: IndicatorTopLeft = "top-left"
97: IndicatorTopRight = "top-right"
98: IndicatorBottomLeft = "bottom-left"
99: IndicatorBottomRight = "bottom-right"
100: )
101:
102: // Indicator configures the small blinking red dot shown on the streamer's own
103: // screen while a stream is live. It is always on top and stays out of the
104: // capture, so viewers never see it.
105: type Indicator struct {
106: Enabled bool `json:"enabled"`
107: // Position is one of the Indicator* constants above.
108: Position string `json:"position"`
109: }
110:
111: // Capture holds the "what do we record" settings, including the automatic
112: // target selection rules described in INSTRUCTIONS.md.
113: type Capture struct {
114: // DefaultTarget is used when the hotkey cannot find a fullscreen app.
115: DefaultTarget string `json:"defaultTarget"`
116: // MonitorIndex is the monitor used when DefaultTarget is "monitor".
117: MonitorIndex int `json:"monitorIndex"`
118: // AlwaysShowPicker disables auto-selection entirely.
119: AlwaysShowPicker bool `json:"alwaysShowPicker"`
120: // DesktopAudio captures system render audio, including all apps
121: // routed to that device. When ExcludeDiscordAudio is enabled, Windows
122: // process loopback excludes the Discord desktop client's process tree.
123: DesktopAudio bool `json:"desktopAudio"`
124: ExcludeDiscordAudio bool `json:"excludeDiscordAudio"`
125: }
126:
127: // Encoding holds the ffmpeg related settings.
128: type Encoding struct {
129: Encoder string `json:"encoder"`
130: // FFmpegPath is an explicit path to ffmpeg.exe; empty means "look it up on
131: // PATH".
132: FFmpegPath string `json:"ffmpegPath"`
133: // Resolution is "source" (no scaling) or an explicit "1920x1080".
134: Resolution string `json:"resolution"`
135: FPS int `json:"fps"`
136: // BitrateKbps is the target video bitrate in kilobits per second.
137: BitrateKbps int `json:"bitrateKbps"`
138: // KeyframeSeconds is the GOP length. About one per second keeps new viewers
139: // waiting at most a second before they can decode.
140: KeyframeSeconds int `json:"keyframeSeconds"`
141: // EncoderThreads is passed to libx264 (0 means "let ffmpeg decide").
142: EncoderThreads int `json:"encoderThreads"`
143: // ExtraEncoderArgs are appended to the ffmpeg command line, for tuning.
144: ExtraEncoderArgs []string `json:"extraEncoderArgs"`
145: }
146:
147: // Stream holds the WebRTC settings, the optional Discord Activity relay and
148: // the optional Discord bot notification.
149: type Stream struct {
150: MaxViewers int `json:"maxViewers"`
151: STUNServers []string `json:"stunServers"`
152: TURNServers []TURNServer `json:"turnServers"`
153: // Discord configures the local bot that posts the public viewer link.
154: Discord DiscordBot `json:"discord"`
155: // Relay is the optional Discord Activity WebSocket output. It can run
156: // alongside WebRTC or replace it entirely.
157: Relay Relay `json:"relay"`
158: // Stack controls the local bot/relay/gateway/tunnel process.
159: Stack LocalBot `json:"stack"`
160: }
161:
162: // Relay configures the publisher side of the Activity relay.
163: type Relay struct {
164: // Enabled turns the WebSocket output on.
165: Enabled bool `json:"enabled"`
166: // URL is the relay base URL, e.g. wss://relay.example.com.
167: URL string `json:"url"`
168: // Token is the relay's deployment-wide publisher secret.
169: Token string `json:"token"`
170: // ChannelID is the fallback Discord channel whose Activity should share
171: // this stream. When the streamer is in a voice channel, the bot resolves
172: // that voice channel instead. The relay room ID is exactly the resolved
173: // channel ID, so viewers in that channel's Activity join the same room.
174: ChannelID string `json:"channelID"`
175: // ActivityRoom is a fixed Discord channel ID to use as the Activity relay
176: // room. When set, the desktop app publishes to this room directly instead
177: // of resolving the streamer's voice channel. This allows the Activity to
178: // work from any channel while all viewers join the same shared room.
179: // If empty, the voice channel resolution is used (falling back to ChannelID).
180: ActivityRoom string `json:"activityRoom"`
181: // Only skips Cloudflare signaling and WebRTC entirely. Useful for a
182: // Discord-only deployment.
183: Only bool `json:"only"`
184: // Cloudflared enables automatic Cloudflare tunnel (cloudflared) for the
185: // Activity stack. When true, the Activity stack starts cloudflared and
186: // registers the tunnel URL with the bot so the viewer link is public HTTPS.
187: Cloudflared bool `json:"cloudflared"`
188: // NotifyURL and NotifyKey let the bot post a Watch message when a stream
189: // starts. Leave NotifyURL empty to disable notifications.
190: NotifyURL string `json:"notifyURL"`
191: NotifyKey string `json:"notifyKey"`
192: // DiscordClientID is the Discord Application (Client) ID for the Activity OAuth flow.
193: // If empty, it will be read from the viewer's config.json.
194: DiscordClientID string `json:"discordClientID"`
195: // DiscordClientSecret is the Discord Application secret for the Activity OAuth flow.
196: // This must be obtained from the Discord Developer Portal.
197: DiscordClientSecret string `json:"discordClientSecret"`
198: // IdentitySecret is the HMAC secret for signing identity tokens (min 32 chars).
199: // If empty, a random secret will be generated and saved on first run.
200: IdentitySecret string `json:"identitySecret"`
201: }
202:
203: // DiscordBot configures the local bot notification.
204: type DiscordBot struct {
205: // ChannelID is the Discord channel that receives the public viewer link.
206: ChannelID string `json:"channelID"`
207: // NotifyURL and NotifyKey let the bot post or delete the link. Leave
208: // NotifyURL empty to disable notifications.
209: NotifyURL string `json:"notifyURL"`
210: NotifyKey string `json:"notifyKey"`
211: }
212:
213: // LocalBot configures the local Discord bot/Activity stack launcher.
214: //
215: // The desktop app runs the built-in `streamy bot` subcommand when Script is
216: // empty, and stops it again on quit. When the Activity relay is enabled, Script
217: // can point at start-activity.ps1 (development) or start-stack.ps1 (installed),
218: // which starts the relay, bot, gateway and Cloudflare tunnel together.
219: type LocalBot struct {
220: // AutoStart launches the bot/stack together with Streamy.
221: AutoStart bool `json:"autoStart"`
222: // Script is an explicit path to a launcher script. Empty means use the
223: // built-in Go bot, or auto-detect an Activity stack script.
224: Script string `json:"script"`
225: // PublishToken is passed to the relay as its publisher secret.
226: PublishToken string `json:"publishToken"`
227: }
228:
229: // UnmarshalJSON reads the Activity relay block that older configs stored under
230: // stream.relay. The same object is still valid today, but it used to be the
231: // only notification configuration, so a config with stream.discord empty also
232: // inherits its notify fields.
233: func (s *Stream) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {
234: type streamJSON Stream
235: var raw struct {
236: *streamJSON
237: LegacyRelay *Relay `json:"relay"`
238: }
239: raw.streamJSON = (*streamJSON)(s)
240: if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &raw); err != nil {
241: return err
242: }
243: // The explicit LegacyRelay field above shadows the embedded Relay field for
244: // the "relay" key, so json.Unmarshal fills raw.LegacyRelay and leaves
245: // s.Relay at its zero value. Copy it back: stream.relay is still the live
246: // Activity configuration, not just a source of legacy notify settings.
247: if raw.LegacyRelay != nil {
248: s.Relay = *raw.LegacyRelay
249: if s.Discord == (DiscordBot{}) {
250: s.Discord = DiscordBot{
251: ChannelID: raw.LegacyRelay.ChannelID,
252: NotifyURL: raw.LegacyRelay.NotifyURL,
253: NotifyKey: raw.LegacyRelay.NotifyKey,
254: }
255: }
256: }
257: return nil
258: }
259:
260: // TURNServer is one relay, used when a direct peer-to-peer path is impossible.
261: type TURNServer struct {
262: URLs []string `json:"urls"`
263: Username string `json:"username"`
264: Credential string `json:"credential"`
265: }
266:
267: // Signaling points at the Cloudflare Worker written in phase 4.
268: type Signaling struct {
269: URL string `json:"url"`
270: ViewerURL string `json:"viewerURL"`
271: }
272:
273: // Update controls automatic update checking from GitHub releases.
274: type Update struct {
275: // Enabled turns on periodic update checks.
276: Enabled bool `json:"enabled"`
277: // Repo is the GitHub repository in "owner/repo" format.
278: Repo string `json:"repo"`
279: // CheckIntervalDays is how often to check for updates (0 = default 7 days).
280: CheckIntervalDays int `json:"checkIntervalDays"`
281: // AutoUpdateDisabled disables automatic periodic update checks.
282: // If an update is marked as required, it will still notify regardless.
283: AutoUpdateDisabled bool `json:"autoUpdateDisabled"`
284: }

287: // file is decoded on top of.
288: func Default() Config {
289: return Config{
290: Schema: CurrentSchema,
291: LogLevel: "info",
292: RunAtStartup: true,
293: Hotkey: Hotkey{
294: Enabled: true,
295: Toggle: "Ctrl+Shift+F9",
296: Picker: "Ctrl+Shift+F10",
297: },
298: Capture: Capture{
299: DefaultTarget: TargetPrimary,
300: MonitorIndex: 0,
301: DesktopAudio: true,
302: ExcludeDiscordAudio: true,
303: },
304: Indicator: Indicator{
305: Enabled: true,
306: Position: IndicatorTopRight,
307: },
308: Encoding: Encoding{
309: Encoder: EncoderAuto,
310: Resolution: "source",
311: FPS: 30,
312: BitrateKbps: 6000,
313: KeyframeSeconds: 1,
314: },
315: Stream: Stream{
316: MaxViewers: 10,
317: // Google's public STUN servers: free, no account, good enough to
318: // discover your public address for most home networks.
319: STUNServers: []string{
320: "stun:stun.l.google.com:19302",
321: "stun:stun1.l.google.com:19302",
322: },
323: Relay: Relay{
324: Enabled: true,
325: Only: true,
326: URL: "ws://127.0.0.1:8080/.proxy/relay",
327: Token: "dev-token",
328: ActivityRoom: "123456789012345678",
329: Cloudflared: true,
330: },
331: Stack: LocalBot{AutoStart: true},
332: },
333: Signaling: Signaling{
334: URL: DefaultSignalingURL,
335: ViewerURL: DefaultViewerURL,
336: },
337: Update: Update{

340: CheckIntervalDays: 1,

342: },
343: }
344: }
345:
346: // Dir returns the directory Streamy keeps its config and logs in.
347: func Dir() (string, error) {
348: base, err := os.UserConfigDir()
349: if err != nil {
350: return "", fmt.Errorf("locate user config directory: %w", err)
351: }
352: return filepath.Join(base, AppDirName), nil
353: }
354:
355: // DefaultPath returns the path of the default config file.
356: func DefaultPath() (string, error) {
357: dir, err := Dir()
358: if err != nil {
359: return "", err
360: }
361: return filepath.Join(dir, "config.json"), nil
362: }
363:
364: // LogPath returns the path of the default log file.
365: func LogPath() (string, error) {
366: dir, err := Dir()
367: if err != nil {
368: return "", err
369: }
370: return filepath.Join(dir, "streamy.log"), nil
371: }
372:
373: // Load reads the config from the default location.
374: func Load() (Config, bool, error) {
375: path, err := DefaultPath()
376: if err != nil {
377: return Config{}, false, err
378: }
379: return LoadFrom(path)
380: }
381:
382: // LoadFrom reads the config from path. A missing file is not an error: the
383: // defaults are written there and returned, with created reporting that this
384: // happened.
385: func LoadFrom(path string) (cfg Config, created bool, err error) {
386: data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
387: switch {
388: case errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist):
389: cfg = Default()
390: if bundled, ok := bundledDefault(); ok {
391: cfg = bundled
392: }
393: if err := cfg.SaveTo(path); err != nil {
394: return cfg, false, err
395: }
396: return cfg, true, nil
397: case err != nil:
398: return Config{}, false, fmt.Errorf("read config: %w", err)
399: }
400:
401: // The file is meant to be hand editable, and a good few Windows tools still
402: // write a UTF-8 byte order mark at the start: PowerShell's Set-Content, and
403: // any editor set to "UTF-8 with BOM". JSON does not allow one, and the
404: // failure is nasty, because the settings look fine and are silently
405: // ignored in favour of the defaults. Strip it instead of complaining.
406: data = bytes.TrimPrefix(data, []byte{0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF})
407:
408: // Unknown fields are deliberately ignored, so a config written by a newer
409: // version still loads in an older one.
410: cfg = Default()
411: if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &cfg); err != nil {
412: return Config{}, false, fmt.Errorf("parse config: %w", err)
413: }
414: if strings.TrimSpace(cfg.Signaling.URL) == "" {
415: cfg.Signaling.URL = DefaultSignalingURL
416: }
417: if strings.TrimSpace(cfg.Signaling.ViewerURL) == "" {
418: cfg.Signaling.ViewerURL = DefaultViewerURL
419: }
420: // Configs written before the branch change still point at the frozen
421: // alias; rewrite them so shared links reach the current deployment.
422: if isLegacyViewerURL(cfg.Signaling.ViewerURL) {
423: cfg.Signaling.ViewerURL = DefaultViewerURL
424: }
425: if err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {
426: return cfg, false, err
427: }
428: return cfg, false, nil
429: }
430:
431: // bundledDefault reads config.default.json next to the executable. An installer
432: // ships the user's Discord bot and stream settings there, so a fresh install has
433: // working notifications instead of the generic defaults. A malformed file is
434: // ignored: a bad packaging step must not stop Streamy from starting.
435: func bundledDefault() (Config, bool) {
436: self, err := os.Executable()
437: if err != nil {
438: return Config{}, false
439: }
440: data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(self), "config.default.json"))
441: if err != nil {
442: return Config{}, false
443: }
444: data = bytes.TrimPrefix(data, []byte{0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF})
445: cfg := Default()
446: if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &cfg); err != nil {
447: return Config{}, false
448: }
449: if err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {
450: return Config{}, false
451: }
452: return cfg, true
453: }
454:
455: // isLegacyViewerURL reports whether raw points at the branch alias that no
456: // longer receives new deployments.
457: func isLegacyViewerURL(raw string) bool {
458: u, err := url.Parse(strings.TrimSpace(raw))
459: if err != nil {
460: return false
461: }
462: return strings.EqualFold(u.Host, legacyViewerHost)
463: }
464:
465: // Save writes the config to the default location.
466: func (c Config) Save() error {
467: path, err := DefaultPath()
468: if err != nil {
469: return err
470: }
471: return c.SaveTo(path)
472: }
473:
474: // SaveTo writes the config to path atomically.
475: func (c Config) SaveTo(path string) error {
476: c.Schema = CurrentSchema
477:
478: if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
479: return fmt.Errorf("create config directory: %w", err)
480: }
481:
482: data, err := json.MarshalIndent(c, "", " ")
483: if err != nil {
484: return fmt.Errorf("encode config: %w", err)
485: }
486: data = append(data, '\n')
487:
488: // Write to a sibling temp file first so a partial write can never be
489: // swapped in. os.Rename replaces the destination on both Windows and Unix.
490: tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".config-\*.json")
491: if err != nil {
492: return fmt.Errorf("create temp config: %w", err)
493: }
494: tmpName := tmp.Name()
495: defer func() {
496: // Best effort cleanup if we bail out before the rename.
497: _ = os.Remove(tmpName)
498: }()
499:
500: if _, err := tmp.Write(data); err != nil {
501: tmp.Close()
502: return fmt.Errorf("write temp config: %w", err)
503: }
504: if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
505: return fmt.Errorf("close temp config: %w", err)
506: }
507: if err := os.Rename(tmpName, path); err != nil {
508: return fmt.Errorf("replace config: %w", err)
509: }
510: return nil
511: }
512:
513: // Validate checks the values a user could have typed by hand, so mistakes are
514: // reported at startup instead of later inside ffmpeg.
515: func (c Config) Validate() error {
516: var errs []error
517:
518: if c.Schema > CurrentSchema {
519: errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("config schema %d is newer than this build understands (%d)", c.Schema, CurrentSchema))
520: }
521:
522: // Validate activityRoom is a valid Discord channel ID when set
523: if id := strings.TrimSpace(c.Stream.Relay.ActivityRoom); id != "" && !discordChannelRe.MatchString(id) {
524: errs = append(errs, errors.New("stream.relay.activityRoom: must be a Discord channel ID"))
525: }
526:
527: if c.Hotkey.Enabled {
528: if _, err := hotkey.Parse(c.Hotkey.Toggle); err != nil {
529: errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("hotkey.toggle: %w", err))
530: }
531: }
532: if _, err := hotkey.Parse(c.Hotkey.Picker); err != nil {
533: errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("hotkey.picker: %w", err))
534: }
535:
536: switch c.Capture.DefaultTarget {
537: case TargetPrimary, TargetFocused, TargetMonitor:
538: case "":
539: errs = append(errs, errors.New("capture.defaultTarget: must not be empty"))
540: default:
541: errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("capture.defaultTarget: unknown value %q", c.Capture.DefaultTarget))
542: }
543: if c.Capture.MonitorIndex < 0 {
544: errs = append(errs, errors.New("capture.monitorIndex: must not be negative"))
545: }
546:
547: switch c.Indicator.Position {
548: case IndicatorTopLeft, IndicatorTopRight, IndicatorBottomLeft, IndicatorBottomRight:
549: case "":
550: errs = append(errs, errors.New("indicator.position: must not be empty"))
551: default:
552: errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("indicator.position: unknown value %q (want top-left, top-right, bottom-left or bottom-right)", c.Indicator.Position))
553: }
554:
555: switch c.Encoding.Encoder {
556: case EncoderAuto, EncoderNVENC, EncoderQSV, EncoderAMF, EncoderX264:
557: case "":
558: errs = append(errs, errors.New("encoding.encoder: must not be empty"))
559: default:
560: errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("encoding.encoder: unknown value %q (want auto, nvenc, qsv, amf or x264)", c.Encoding.Encoder))
561: }
562: if err := validateResolution(c.Encoding.Resolution); err != nil {
563: errs = append(errs, err)
564: }
565: if c.Encoding.FPS < 1 || c.Encoding.FPS > 240 {
566: errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("encoding.fps: %d is out of range (1-240)", c.Encoding.FPS))
567: }
568: if c.Encoding.BitrateKbps < 100 {
569: errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("encoding.bitrateKbps: %d is too low (minimum 100)", c.Encoding.BitrateKbps))
570: }
571: if c.Encoding.KeyframeSeconds < 1 || c.Encoding.KeyframeSeconds > 10 {
572: errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("encoding.keyframeSeconds: %d is out of range (1-10)", c.Encoding.KeyframeSeconds))
573: }
574: if c.Encoding.EncoderThreads < 0 {
575: errs = append(errs, errors.New("encoding.encoderThreads: must not be negative"))
576: }
577:
578: if c.Stream.MaxViewers < 0 {
579: errs = append(errs, errors.New("stream.maxViewers: must not be negative"))
580: } else if c.Stream.MaxViewers > 20 {
581: errs = append(errs, errors.New("stream.maxViewers: must not exceed the Worker hard limit of 20"))
582: }
583: for i, server := range c.Stream.STUNServers {
584: if err := validateICEServerURL(server, "stun", "stuns"); err != nil {
585: errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("stream.stunServers[%d]: %w", i, err))
586: }
587: }
588: for i, server := range c.Stream.TURNServers {
589: if len(server.URLs) == 0 {
590: errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("stream.turnServers[%d].urls: must contain at least one URL", i))
591: }
592: for j, serverURL := range server.URLs {
593: if err := validateICEServerURL(serverURL, "turn", "turns"); err != nil {
594: errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("stream.turnServers[%d].urls[%d]: %w", i, j, err))
595: }
596: }
597: }
598:
599: switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(c.LogLevel)) {
600: case "", "debug", "info", "warn", "warning", "error":
601: default:
602: errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("logLevel: unknown level %q", c.LogLevel))
603: }
604:
605: if u := strings.TrimSpace(c.Signaling.URL); u != "" {
606: parsed, err := url.Parse(u)
607: if err != nil {
608: errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("signaling.url: %w", err))
609: } else if (parsed.Scheme != "ws" && parsed.Scheme != "wss") || parsed.Host == "" {
610: errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("signaling.url: must be an absolute ws or wss URL, got %q", u))
611: }
612: }
613: if u := strings.TrimSpace(c.Signaling.ViewerURL); u != "" {
614: parsed, err := url.Parse(u)
615: if err != nil {
616: errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("signaling.viewerURL: %w", err))
617: } else if (parsed.Scheme != "https" && parsed.Scheme != "http") || parsed.Host == "" {
618: errs = append(errs, errors.New("signaling.viewerURL: must be an absolute http or https URL"))
619: }
620: }
621:
622: if c.Update.Enabled {
623: if strings.TrimSpace(c.Update.Repo) == "" {
624: errs = append(errs, errors.New("update.repo: must not be empty when update is enabled"))
625: } else if !strings.Contains(c.Update.Repo, "/") {
626: errs = append(errs, errors.New("update.repo: must be in 'owner/repo' format"))
627: }
628: if c.Update.CheckIntervalDays < 0 {
629: errs = append(errs, errors.New("update.checkIntervalDays: must not be negative"))
630: }
631: }
632:
633: discord := c.Stream.Discord
634: if u := strings.TrimSpace(discord.NotifyURL); u != "" {
635: parsed, err := url.Parse(u)
636: if err != nil {
637: errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("stream.discord.notifyURL: %w", err))
638: } else if (parsed.Scheme != "https" && parsed.Scheme != "http") || parsed.Host == "" {
639: errs = append(errs, errors.New("stream.discord.notifyURL: must be an absolute http or https URL"))
640: }
641: if strings.TrimSpace(discord.NotifyKey) == "" {
642: errs = append(errs, errors.New("stream.discord.notifyKey: required when notifyURL is set"))
643: }
644: }
645: if id := strings.TrimSpace(discord.ChannelID); id != "" && !discordChannelRe.MatchString(id) {
646: errs = append(errs, errors.New("stream.discord.channelID: must be a Discord channel ID"))
647: }
648:
649: relay := c.Stream.Relay
650: if relay.Only && !relay.Enabled {
651: errs = append(errs, errors.New("stream.relay.only: requires stream.relay.enabled"))
652: }
653: // activityRoom validation moved to the main validation section above
654: if relay.Enabled {
655: if u := strings.TrimSpace(relay.URL); u == "" {
656: errs = append(errs, errors.New("stream.relay.url: required when the relay is enabled"))
657: } else if parsed, err := url.Parse(u); err != nil {
658: errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("stream.relay.url: %w", err))
659: } else if (parsed.Scheme != "ws" && parsed.Scheme != "wss") || parsed.Host == "" {
660: errs = append(errs, errors.New("stream.relay.url: must be an absolute ws or wss URL"))
661: }
662: if strings.TrimSpace(relay.Token) == "" {
663: errs = append(errs, errors.New("stream.relay.token: required when the relay is enabled"))
664: }
665: }
666: if id := strings.TrimSpace(relay.ChannelID); id != "" && !discordChannelRe.MatchString(id) {
667: errs = append(errs, errors.New("stream.relay.channelID: must be a Discord channel ID"))
668: }
669: if u := strings.TrimSpace(relay.NotifyURL); u != "" {
670: parsed, err := url.Parse(u)
671: if err != nil {
672: errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("stream.relay.notifyURL: %w", err))
673: } else if (parsed.Scheme != "https" && parsed.Scheme != "http") || parsed.Host == "" {
674: errs = append(errs, errors.New("stream.relay.notifyURL: must be an absolute http or https URL"))
675: }
676: if strings.TrimSpace(relay.NotifyKey) == "" {
677: errs = append(errs, errors.New("stream.relay.notifyKey: required when notifyURL is set"))
678: }
679: }
680:
681: return errors.Join(errs...)
682: }
683:
684: func validateICEServerURL(raw string, schemes ...string) error {
685: value := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
686: parsed, err := url.Parse(value)
687: if err != nil {
688: return err
689: }
690: if parsed.Opaque == "" && parsed.Host == "" {
691: return errors.New("must include a server address")
692: }
693: for _, scheme := range schemes {
694: if parsed.Scheme == scheme {
695: return nil
696: }
697: }
698: return fmt.Errorf("scheme must be %s", strings.Join(schemes, " or "))
699: }
700:
701: // discordChannelRe matches a Discord snowflake as accepted by the bot.
702: var discordChannelRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^\d{5,32}$`)
703:
704: // resolutionRe matches "1920x1080" and similar.
705: var resolutionRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^(\d{2,5})x(\d{2,5})$`)
706:
707: func validateResolution(res string) error {
708: value := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(res))
709: if value == "source" {
710: return nil
711: }
712: m := resolutionRe.FindStringSubmatch(value)
713: if m == nil {
714: return fmt.Errorf("encoding.resolution: %q is not \"source\" or WIDTHxHEIGHT", res)
715: }
716: for _, part := range m[1:] {
717: n, err := strconv.Atoi(part)
718: if err != nil || n == 0 {
719: return fmt.Errorf("encoding.resolution: %q has a non positive dimension", res)
720: }
721: }
722: return nil
723: }
